_comment: Golden vectors for the voxel_set region (the label tool click-to-pick). Asserted by src/renderer/lib/voxelSet.test.ts (voxelSetPredicate, the live preview) and backend-api/tests/test_segment_pick.py (label_segments.voxel_set_mask, what the session labels). A point is in when floor((p - origin) / voxel) is one of the keys; keys are base64 little-endian int32 (i, j, k) triplets, here (0,0,0), (2,1,0), (-1,0,3).
